results.title: Within Temptation @ Summer Breeze 2025
results.original_title: Within Temptation Live at Summer Breeze 2025
results.overview: One of the leading bands in symphonic metal, Within Temptation is masterfully led by singer Sharon den Adel who brings exceptional vocals together with fierce guitar riffs and sumptuous orchestral arrangements. Here, the Dutch band deliver a captivating performance at Summer Breeze, combining dramatic emotion with a multilayered sound.  Setlist: "We Go to War", "Bleed Out", "In the Middle of the Night", "Angels", "Faster", "Paradise (What About Us?)", "Stand My Ground", "Wireless", "Supernova", "Don't Pray for Me", "Lost", "The Reckoning", "Ice Queen", "Our Solemn Hour", "Mother Earth"

results.title: Samurai Detective Onihei: White plum allure
results.original_title: 鬼平犯科帳 暗剣白梅香
results.overview: A mysterious assassin cloaked in a haunting, seductive fragrance sets his sights on Heizo Hasegawa. Hanjiro Kaneko, a master swordsman, attacks with deadly precision, leaving Heizo to uncover the truth behind the strange scent of "White Plum Allure."  As Heizo digs deeper, he discovers a tangled web of deception involving Hiko-no-Ichi, a blind decoy working for the notorious bandit leader Heijuro the Snake.

results.title: Cimarron
results.overview: In 18th-century Martinique, Mathieu, a slave working on a sugar cane plantation, is sentenced to death for trying to escape with his wife and child. However, the judge offers him a reprieve on condition that he agrees to leave for Canada to work as an executioner. With no other choice, the young man accepts.

results.title: Door's Unlocked
results.overview: When night falls, Josh makes his way around town to meet with strangers and friends.

results.title: If I Make It to the Morning
results.overview: On the last leg of a college tour across America, accompanied by her mother, a Chinese teenager considers studying and living in New York, with her aunt, who seems to have a perfect life. But in the time of a crab dinner, tensions rise, and the protagonist finds herself alone in the New York night, fantasizing about her future.

results.title: A Film About Toby
results.overview: Toby lives a pretty normal life...that is, until he realizes he's trapped inside a film. What's worse? It's a student film.

results.title: Situações Delicadas
results.overview: Olívia, Marta, and Carlota are three friends leading normal lives, until a moment of panic changes everything: an unexpected confrontation with Jaime, Olívia’s ex-boyfriend, ends tragically when he dies accidentally. Consumed by the fear of losing their freedom during the best years of their lives, the three make a radical decision - to hide the body and conceal what happened that night.

results.title: La chica de Ipanema
results.overview: Juan, a young man from Buenos Aires worn down by routine, lives through a day that becomes increasingly strange after meeting Elo, his neighbor. His search to find her again distorts time and blurs the line between reality and imagination. An urban romantic comedy with dreamlike touches that explores the desire for connection—and the thin boundary between infatuation and delusion.

results.title: Buona Fortuna
results.overview: On the Sicilian seaside, a counterfeiter and a pickpocket cross paths.

results.title: Unseen Enemy
results.overview: An isolated private investigator is convinced by a friend to come out of hiding to help find her missing sister, putting him back in reach by those who want his family dead.

results.title: Self-Titled
results.overview: Shots around a house and outside. Experimenting with colors and shots.

results.title: La Jetée: The Fifth Shot
results.original_title: Le Cinquième Plan de « La Jetée »
results.overview: In Paris, at an exhibition on the French writer, photographer and filmmaker Chris Marker (1921-2012), Jean-Henri Cabrera thinks he sees himself in a specific shot of the short film La Jetée, directed by Marker in 1962.

results.title: Ado SPECIAL LIVE "Shinzou" in Cinema
results.original_title: 劇場版 Ado SPECIAL LIVE「心臓」
results.overview: Attracting 140,000 fans over two days (April 27–28, 2024), “Shinzou” was a legendary performance that established Ado the first solo female artist to perform at the iconic Japan National Stadium. The setlist featured 26 songs including her on-stage duet of “Sakura Biyori and Time Machine (with Hatsune Miku),” the highly acclaimed “DIGNITY” featuring guest guitarist Tak Matsumoto (from B’z), and “Show,” a collaboration song with Universal Studios Japan. The theatrical release promises a fresh and immersive experience for fans who missed the live event or want to relive the moment.

results.title: Até Amanhã
results.overview: Tiago and Letícia study in Curitiba, Brazil. Facing an uncertain future, the couple meets with friends to celebrate a birthday party. Meanwhile, they must make an important decision about their relationship.

results.title: The Disappearance of Captain Nairac
results.overview: May 1977. Undercover British army Captain Robert Nairac is abducted and killed by the IRA - his body secretly buried. Decades on, a former enemy searches for his remains.

results.title: Mensonges Blancs
results.overview: An investigator pays a young couple a visit after the brutal deaths of their family.

results.title: Aachari Baa
results.overview: An elderly Gujarati grandmother reconnects with her family through her cherished pickle-making tradition, bringing warmth and flavor to her community.
